note: Set A uses correct and consistent component entities ('rotor', 'blade') for all claims, whereas Set B incorrectly binds rotor properties to the model name ('CCBlade...') in four claims. Both sets share significant reading errors on the force plots (claiming values exceeding the 800 N/m axis limit and misreading low-wind curves), but Set A more completely extracts the 'Design Point' coordinates (capturing both TSR and Pitch) while Set B misses the pitch angle. Set A is preferred for better entity binding and completeness on the design point.
